5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
7	
8	/-!
9	# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback
10	
11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
17	
18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
22	
23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
25	-/
26	
27	set_option autoImplicit false
28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
29	
30	universe u
31	
32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
34	
35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
36	
37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
39	
40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
43	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
44	
45	noncomputable section
46	
47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
50	
51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
53	
54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
58	
59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
64	
65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
69	
70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
71	
72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
73	
74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
80	
81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
82	
83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
88	
89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
93	
94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
98	
99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
104	  inv := E.divisor
105	  hom_inv_id := h
106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
107	
108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
109	
110	/--
111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
112	
113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
118	
119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
122	-/
123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
127	  W : X.Opens
128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
129	  restrictedValue_eq :
130	    restrictedValue =
131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
133	  nativePresentation :
134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
138	
139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
140	
141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
144	
145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
147	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
151	
152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
156	
157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
162	
163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
165	def FibreFactorizationClause
166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
169	      g.app (op S) w →
170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
172	
173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
176	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
177	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
180	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
181	
182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
189	
190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
191	
192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
198	  IsPullback
199	    F.evaluationDivisor
200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
202	    g
203	
204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
205	test scheme. -/
206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
210	  intro S v w hvw
211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
213	  have hcompat :
214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
216	        g.app (op S) w := by
217	    have h := congrArg
218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
219	    change
220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
223	    rw [h]
224	    exact hvw
225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
231	  calc
232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
235	      (E.divisor_abel_app S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app S v
239	
240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
241	
242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
248	  W := F.W
249	  fst := F.fst
250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
251	  exists_factor := by
252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb
254	
255	@[simp]
256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).W = F.W :=
260	  rfl
261	
262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).isPullback
267	
268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
269	
270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
280	  intro X g
281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback (hpb X g)
282	
283	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
284	
285	end
286	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!

Two converse-direction bricks for the rank-one openness lane.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp` (D0) — **testPoint naturality

  to an equation of slice morphisms through a `k`-algebra map of the two residue fields.

  `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`, whose `Spec.preimage` performs it once.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness` (D1) — **the field
  converse of the presentation contract**: a `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a
  genus-degree class over a field `K` yields `IsSplitWitness` for that class.  The
  splitting field is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the presentation's
  étale cover (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`); the presenting
  equation is the plus-class field collapse (`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom`) read

  `H¹`-vanishing through the datum dictionary

/-- **testPoint naturality as an equation of slice morphisms** (Task-C D0).  For a
morphism of tests `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t : T'.left`, there is a
`k`-algebra map `φ : κ(f t) →ₐ[k] κ(t)` through which the field point of `t` composed
with `f` is the field point of `f t`.

underlying map of the connecting morphism is `Spec` of `Over.testPointFieldMap f t`, and
its `k`-algebra structure is recovered by `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`
rather than assembled by hand. -/
theorem Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp
    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
    ∃ φ : Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) →ₐ[k]

        = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t) := by
  have hw : Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
        ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom

with a subsingleton factor is a subsingleton. -/
private theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left

-- budget (same as `isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom`).
/-- **The field converse of the rank-one presentation contract** (Task-C D1): a
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a genus-degree class over a field `K` makes that class a
split witness.

presentation's étale cover.  The presenting Čech class is the image of the presentation's
own `P.datum.cechPicClass` under the carrier-to-`L` refinement, by the plus-class field
collapse; its witness divisor with vanishing `H¹` exists because the presentation's
`h1_vanishing` field survives the coefficient extension to `L` (`0 ⊗ = 0`), which is
exactly the datum dictionary's condition at `L`. -/
theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hKL, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
    P.cover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
  letI := hLf
  letI := hKL
  letI := hLfin
  letI := hLsep
  letI hkL : Algebra k L := ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
  haveI htowkKL : IsScalarTower k K L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
  letI hBL : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI htowKBL : IsScalarTower K P.cover.Carrier L :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
  haveI htowkBL : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    change algebraMap k L x = ψ (algebraMap k P.cover.Carrier x)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K P.cover.Carrier, ψ.commutes,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L]
  have hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K lam.1)
      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom C P.representative ψ,
      P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
  have hsub : Subsingleton ((datumPair P.datum).H1 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] L) :=
    subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
      ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hW1⟩ :=
    (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mpr hsub
  exact isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C lam.1
    (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L) P.datum.cechPicClass)
    hM W hW hW1

condition** — the converse of `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness`, obtained by testing
the membership contract with the identity of `overSpec k K`.  Together the two theorems
characterize the rank-one locus fibrewise at fields. -/
theorem isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K))) :
    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp h K (𝟙 (overSpec k K))
  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
        (𝟙 (overSpec k K)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
    picEtMap_id C lam.1
  have hsplit := P.isSplitWitness
  rwa [e] at hsplit

import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.EtaleCover
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffMap

/-!
# Faithfully-flat descent for the widened divisor functor, via representability

The widened divisor functor `divFunctorAff C (genus C)` is representable
(`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`, `Picard/DivRepAffChallenge.lean`), and over an affine
test the functor value collapses to `DivFamZarAff` (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv`,
`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffVehicle.lean`).  Composing the two turns a widened class over a test
algebra into a **classifying morphism** to the representing scheme, naturally in the algebra
(`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffMap.lean`).

This file cashes that in for descent: `Spec` of a faithfully flat ring map is quasi-compact,
surjective and flat, hence an **effective epimorphism** of schemes by the fpqc-subcanonicity
instance (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Fpqc.lean`).  Precomposition with an (effective) epi
is injective, so the widened divisor presheaf is *separated* along faithfully flat maps; and a
class over the carrier of an étale cover whose two coprojection pullbacks to the tensor square
agree has classifying morphism coequalizing the kernel pair of the cover (through
`pullbackSpecIso`), so it *descends*, uniquely, to the base ring.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.classify` — the classifying equivalence
  `DivFamZarAff C S (genus C) ≃ (overSpec k S ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)`, with naturality
  `DivFamZarAff.classify_mapAlgHom`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat` — `Spec` of a faithfully flat
  algebra map is an effective epimorphism.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat` — the
  separated-presheaf property of the widened carrier along faithfully flat maps.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` — effective-epi descent of a
  widened divisor class along an étale cover of the test algebra.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- **The classifying equivalence of the widened divisor functor at an affine test**: a widened
locally certified divisor class of degree `genus C` over a test algebra `S` is the same thing as
a morphism from `Spec S` to the representing scheme, through the affine collapse
`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` and the representability `divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`. -/
noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.classify (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
    DivFamZarAff C S (genus C) ≃ (overSpec k S ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
  (divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C (genus C) S).symm.trans
    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (X := overSpec k S)).symm

/-- **Naturality of the classifying equivalence** along a `k`-algebra map of affine tests: the
classifying morphism of the base change is `Spec` of the map followed by the classifying
morphism.  `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality` composed with the representability coherence
`Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm`. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.classify_mapAlgHom {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    [CommRing S'] [Algebra k S'] (φ : S →ₐ[k] S') (F : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C)) :
    classify S' (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F) = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ classify S F := by
  have hnat := divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality (C := C) (n := genus C) φ
    ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C (genus C) S).symm F)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hnat
  calc classify S' (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F)
      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv.symm
          ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C (genus C) S').symm
            (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F)) := rfl
    _ = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv.symm
          ((divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map (Over.overSpecMap φ).op
            ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C (genus C) S).symm F)) := by
        rw [← hnat, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        rfl
    _ = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv.symm
          ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C (genus C) S).symm F) :=
        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).comp_homEquiv_symm _ _).symm
    _ = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ classify S F := rfl

/-- **`Spec` of a faithfully flat algebra map is an effective epimorphism** of schemes: it is
flat and surjective by `flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff`, quasi-compact because it is affine,
and quasi-compact surjective flat morphisms are effective epis by fpqc subcanonicity. -/
theorem effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra S S'] [Module.FaithfullyFlat S S'] :
    EffectiveEpi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))) := by
  have hff : (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S')).hom.FaithfullyFlat :=
    RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance
  obtain ⟨hflat, hsurj⟩ :=
    (flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))).mpr hff
  haveI := hflat
  haveI := hsurj
  infer_instance

/-- **The separated-presheaf property of the widened carrier**: base change of widened locally
certified divisor classes along a faithfully flat map of test algebras is injective.  Through
`classify`, base change is precomposition of the classifying morphism with `Spec` of the map,
which is an (effective) epimorphism. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k S] [CommRing S'] [Algebra k S'] [Algebra S S'] [IsScalarTower k S S']
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat S S'] :
    Function.Injective
      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (C := C) (n := genus C) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')) := by
  intro F G hFG
  haveI : EffectiveEpi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))) :=
    effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat
  haveI : Epi ((Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')).left) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))))
  haveI : Epi (Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')) :=
    Over.epi_of_epi_left _
  have hc := congrArg (classify S') hFG
  rw [classify_mapAlgHom, classify_mapAlgHom] at hc
  exact (classify S).injective
    ((cancel_epi (Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S'))).mp hc)

/-- **Effective-epi descent of a widened divisor class along an étale cover**: a widened
locally certified divisor class over the carrier of an étale cover of `Spec A` whose two
coprojection pullbacks to the tensor square of the carrier agree descends, uniquely, to a class
over `A`.

The classifying morphism of `F` coequalizes the kernel pair of the covering morphism
`Spec E.Carrier ⟶ Spec A` (the kernel pair is `Spec` of the tensor square, by
`pullbackSpecIso`), so it factors through the effective epi; the factorization lands back in
the slice over `Spec k` by epi cancellation, and uniqueness is the separated-presheaf
property. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
    (h : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
            E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F
        = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
            E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F) :
    ∃! F₀ : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F₀ = F := by
  classical
  haveI : EffectiveEpi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))) :=
    effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat
  -- the double-pullback agreement of classifying morphisms, in the slice over `Spec k`
  have hOv : Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
        ≫ classify E.Carrier F
      = Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
